import time, numpy as np, glob, ctypes
p=glob.glob('/usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/numpy.libs/libscipy_openblas64_*.so')[0]
lib=ctypes.CDLL(p)
f=lib.scipy_LAPACKE_dgeev64_
i64=ctypes.c_longlong
dp=ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)
f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char, ctypes.c_char, i64, dp, i64, dp, dp, dp, i64, dp, i64]
f.restype=ctypes.c_int
ROW=101; COL=102
n=10
A=np.random.normal(size=(n,n)).astype(np.float64)
wr=np.empty(n); wi=np.empty(n); vr=np.empty((n,n)); vl=np.empty((1,1))
# column major copy
Ac=np.array(A, order='F', copy=True)
def run():
    bb=Ac.copy(order='F')
    info=f(COL, b'N', b'V', n, bb.ctypes.data_as(dp), n, wr.ctypes.data_as(dp), wi.ctypes.data_as(dp), vl.ctypes.data_as(dp), 1, vr.ctypes.data_as(dp), n)
    # select
    absv=np.hypot(wr,wi)
    idx=int(np.argmax(absv))
    if wi[idx]==0:
        return complex(wr[idx]), vr[:,idx].copy()
    else:
        # column idx real, idx+1 imag for positive imag
        j=idx if wi[idx]>0 else idx-1
        vec=vr[:,j]+1j*vr[:,j+1]
        if wi[idx]<0: vec=np.conj(vec)
        return complex(wr[idx],wi[idx]), vec
w,v=np.linalg.eig(A); i=np.argmax(abs(w))
print('ref',w[i]); ev,vec=run(); print('got',ev, np.linalg.norm(A@vec-ev*vec))
# Check each dominant
for n in [2,4,6,8,10]:
    A=np.random.normal(size=(n,n)).astype(np.float64)
    Ac=np.array(A, order='F', copy=True)
    wr=np.empty(n); wi=np.empty(n); vr=np.empty((n,n)); vl=np.empty((1,1))
    ts=[]
    for _ in range(200):
        t=time.perf_counter()
        bb=Ac.copy(order='F')
        f(COL, b'N', b'V', n, bb.ctypes.data_as(dp), n, wr.ctypes.data_as(dp), wi.ctypes.data_as(dp), vl.ctypes.data_as(dp), 1, vr.ctypes.data_as(dp), n)
        absv=np.hypot(wr,wi); idx=int(np.argmax(absv))
        if wi[idx]==0: ev=complex(wr[idx]); vec=vr[:,idx].copy()
        else:
            j=idx if wi[idx]>0 else idx-1
            vec=vr[:,j]+1j*vr[:,j+1]
            if wi[idx]<0: vec=np.conj(vec)
            ev=complex(wr[idx],wi[idx])
        ts.append(time.perf_counter()-t)
    print(n, 'lapacke',np.median(ts)*1e6)
# Try row-major without copy
n=10; A=np.random.normal(size=(n,n)).astype(np.float64)
wr=np.empty(n); wi=np.empty(n); vr=np.empty((n,n)); vl=np.empty((1,1))
ts=[]
for _ in range(200):
    t=time.perf_counter()
    bb=A.copy(order='C')
    info=f(ROW, b'N', b'V', n, bb.ctypes.data_as(dp), n, wr.ctypes.data_as(dp), wi.ctypes.data_as(dp), vl.ctypes.data_as(dp), 1, vr.ctypes.data_as(dp), n)
    absv=np.hypot(wr,wi); idx=int(np.argmax(absv))
    if wi[idx]==0: ev=complex(wr[idx]); vec=vr[:,idx].copy()
    else:
        j=idx if wi[idx]>0 else idx-1
        vec=vr[:,j]+1j*vr[:,j+1]

        ev=complex(wr[idx],wi[idx])
    ts.append(time.perf_counter()-t)
print(n,'row lapacke',np.median(ts)*1e6)
